properties.name: Three RocksDB features are researched and measured as speed-ups UNDER the cross-design layer, after it stands: checkpoints (a consistent copy without stopping the engine), SST ingestion (a chunk or design spliced in as files), and one block cache shared by the stores a process holds
properties.statement: Once the cross-design layer (req:every-cross-design-operation-takes-its-other-designs-by-graph-id-under-the-hosts-read-filter) stands, three RocksDB features SHALL be researched and MEASURED against it on flo2.io's registry, each as a possible speed-up and none as a prerequisite: (1) CHECKPOINTS — a consistent, cheap copy of a store taken while the engine runs, for an assembly's source designs and for backup (flo2's nightly backup stops the engine today); (2) SST INGESTION — a chunk taken from another design, or a whole design, spliced in as sorted files rather than key by key, measured against the key-by-key copy the chunk requirement already specifies; (3) A SHARED BLOCK CACHE across every store one process holds, measured against the per-design memory figures of fact:the-per-open-design-cost-measured-in-one-process-2026-09-13 and the 2026-10-10 measurement (about 330 MB for 34 designs open). Each is kept or set aside on its measurement; the research writes its numbers back to this design. Settled as option (c) of dec:idea-cross-design-operations-are-a-primitive-layer-served-by-the-registry-by-graph-id. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
